exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the words below. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni quyidagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (10 ta so'z, 10 ta bo'shliq):
  fans, guest, beeped, completed, get around,
  home, souvenir, heavy, roared, birthplace

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  HEAVY traffic          (zich transport oqimi)
   2  the lions ROARED       (sherlar bo'kirdi)
   3  Peter BEEPED the horn  (signal chaldi)
   4  COMPLETED her education (ta'limini tugatdi)
   5  a wonderful GUEST house (ajoyib mehmon uyi)
   6  Elvis Presley's BIRTHPLACE (tug'ilgan joyi)
   7  GET AROUND the island   (orolni aylanib chiqmoq)
   8  Paris is HOME to ...    (... ning makoni)
   9  The band has got FANS   (muxlislari bor)
  10  a SOUVENIR shop         (sovg'a do'koni)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Shahar markazida zich transport oqimi bor.
   2  Sherlar bo'kirganda bolalar qo'rqib ketishdi.
   3  Piter signal chaldi va yordam so'rab
      qichqirdi.
   4  Malika Diana ta'limini Shveytsariyada
      tugatgan.
   5  Ular dengiz bo'yidagi ajoyib mehmon uyida
      turishdi.
   6  Missisipidagi Tupelo — Elvis Preslining
      tug'ilgan joyi.
   7  Orolni faqat piyoda aylanib chiqishingiz
      mumkin.
   8  Parij ko'plab mashhur aktyorlarning makoni.
   9  Guruhning ko'p mamlakatlarda muxlislari bor.
  10  Biz sovg'a sotib olish uchun sovg'a
      do'konida to'xtadik.


QAYSI SO'Z QAYSI UNITDAN:
  heavy traffic  — Unit 12 (Coursebook 83, 84)
  roared         — Unit 9 (hayvonlar)
  beeped         — Unit 9-10 (transport)
  completed      — Unit 10 (mashhur odamlar)
  guest house    — Unit 12 (turar joy)
  birthplace     — Unit 12 (Coursebook 87 —
                   Shekspirning tug'ilgan joyi)
  get around     — Unit 12 (sayohat)
  home to        — Unit 12 (Coursebook 83 —
                   'It's also home to film stars')
  fans           — Unit 10 (The Price of Fame)
  souvenir shop  — Unit 12 (Grammar 55 — Edinburg
                   xati)


DIQQAT — SO'Z TURLARIGA E'TIBOR BERING:

  FE'LLAR (o'tgan zamonda):
     roared, beeped, completed
  IBORA-FE'L:
     get around  (7-bandda 'can only' dan keyin →
                  ASOSIY shakl)
  OTLAR:
     fans, souvenir, birthplace, guest
  SIFAT:
     heavy
  MAXSUS:
     home  ('be home TO' turg'un birikmasida)


ENG ALDAMChI BANDLAR:

  5-BAND: 'a wonderful ...... HOUSE'
     Bo'shliqdan keyin 'house' turibdi →
     ot + ot birikmasi kerak → 'GUEST house'
     (mehmon uyi — kichik xususiy mehmonxona).

  8-BAND: 'Paris is ...... TO many famous actors.'
     'TO' predlogi bor → 'be HOME to ...'
     turg'un birikmasi.
     Coursebook 83-bet: 'It's also HOME TO film
     stars.'

  7-BAND: 'You can only ...... the island on foot.'
     'can' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl → 'GET AROUND'.
     'get around' = aylanib chiqmoq, yurib
     yurmoq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to roar        = bo'kirmoq (sher, arslon)
  to beep        = signal chalmoq
  a horn         = signal (mashinada)
  to complete    = tugatmoq
  a guest house  = mehmon uyi
  a birthplace   = tug'ilgan joy
  to get around  = aylanib chiqmoq
  a fan          = muxlis
  a souvenir     = esdalik sovg'a
  on foot        = piyoda

tasks.prompt: 1  There is a lot of ............ traffic in the city centre.
tasks.whyUz:
'HEAVY traffic' — turg'un birikma
(zich transport oqimi).
Coursebook 83, 84-betlarda ham bor.
DIQQAT: 'heavy' bu yerda 'og'ir' EMAS.
tasks.speak: 1  There is a lot of ............ traffic in the city centre.

tasks.prompt: 2  The children were scared when the lions ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'to ROAR' = bo'kirmoq (sher, arslon).
O'tgan zamon → ROARED (to'g'ri fe'l).
'were scared' ham o'tgan zamonda.
tasks.speak: 2  The children were scared when the lions ............ .

tasks.prompt: 3  Peter ............ the horn and shouted for help.
tasks.whyUz:
'to BEEP the horn' = signal chalmoq.
O'tgan zamon → BEEPED.
'a horn' = mashinadagi signal.
'and shouted' ham o'tgan zamonda.
tasks.speak: 3  Peter ............ the horn and shouted for help.

tasks.prompt: 4  Princess Diana ............ her education in Switzerland.
tasks.whyUz:
'to COMPLETE one's education' = ta'limini
tugatmoq.
O'tgan zamon → COMPLETED.
Malika Diana — Coursebook 70-71-betlardagi
matndan (Unit 10).
tasks.speak: 4  Princess Diana ............ her education in Switzerland.

tasks.prompt: 5  They stayed in a wonderful ............ house by the sea.
tasks.whyUz:
Bo'shliqdan keyin 'HOUSE' turibdi →
ot + ot birikmasi: 'GUEST HOUSE'.
'a guest house' = mehmon uyi (kichik xususiy
mehmonxona).
'a guest' = mehmon.
tasks.speak: 5  They stayed in a wonderful ............ house by the sea.

tasks.prompt: 6  Tupelo, Mississippi is Elvis Presley's ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'a BIRTHPLACE' = tug'ilgan joy (birth + place).
Coursebook 87-bet: 'Stratford ... is
Shakespeare's BIRTHPLACE.'
Elvis Presli 1935-yilda Tupelo shahrida
tug'ilgan.
tasks.speak: 6  Tupelo, Mississippi is Elvis Presley's ............ .

tasks.prompt: 7  You can only ............ the island on foot.
tasks.whyUz:
'CAN' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli →
GET AROUND.
'to get around' = aylanib chiqmoq, yurib yurmoq.
'ON FOOT' = piyoda (predlog ON).
tasks.speak: 7  You can only ............ the island on foot.

tasks.prompt: 8  Paris is ............ to many famous actors.
tasks.whyUz:
'TO' predlogi bor → 'be HOME TO ...'
turg'un birikmasi (... ning makoni bo'lmoq).
Coursebook 83-bet: 'It's also HOME TO film
stars.'
'home OF' XATO.
tasks.speak: 8  Paris is ............ to many famous actors.

tasks.prompt: 9  The band has got ............ in many countries.
tasks.whyUz:
'a FAN' = muxlis.
'in many countries' → KO'PLIK: FANS.
Unit 10 ('The Price of Fame') mavzusidan.
tasks.speak: 9  The band has got ............ in many countries.

tasks.prompt: 10  We stopped at a ............ shop to buy gifts.
tasks.whyUz:
Bo'shliqdan keyin 'SHOP' turibdi →
ot + ot birikmasi: 'SOUVENIR SHOP' (sovg'a
do'koni).
Grammar 55-betdagi Edinburg xatida ham bor:
'lots of SOUVENIR SHOPS'.
'a gift' = sovg'a.
tasks.speak: 10  We stopped at a ............ shop to buy gifts.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  CROWDED     6  DANGEROUS
   2  NARROW      7  DIFFICULT
   3  NOISY       8  HOT
   4  EXPENSIVE   9  BRAVE
   5  CLEVER     10  INTERESTING


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  LA dagi ko'chalar juda gavjum.
   2  Ko'cha juda tor edi. Tom u bo'ylab hayday
      olmadi.
   3  Katta shaharlar ko'pincha shovqinli va
      ifloslangan bo'ladi.
   4  U tuflini sotib ololmadi, chunki ular juda
      qimmat edi.
   5  U juda aqlli bola. U hamma javoblarni
      biladi.
   6  Daryoga yaqin bormang, u juda xavfli.
   7  Bu qiyin savol. Men unga javob bera
      olmayman.
   8  Juda issiq kun edi, shuning uchun biz
      plyajga bordik.
   9  Yong'in boshlanganda u qo'rqmadi. U juda
      jasur edi.
  10  Menga o'qituvchim yoqadi. Uning darslari
      juda qiziqarli.


HAR BIRIDA IP GAPNING IChIDA:

   1  'The STREETS in LA' — ko'chalar haqida.
      'heavy' faqat 'traffic' bilan keladi
      (1-mashqning 1-bandi).
      → CROWDED.

   2  'Tom COULDN'T DRIVE ALONG IT.'
      Nega hayday olmadi? — chunki ko'cha TOR edi.
      → NARROW ('wide' = keng, teskari).

   3  'and POLLUTED' — salbiy sifatlar qatori.
      'quiet' ijobiy → mos emas.
      → NOISY.

   4  'He COULDN'T BUY the shoes BECAUSE they were
      TOO ......'
      Nega sotib ololmadi? — QIMMAT bo'lgani uchun.
      → EXPENSIVE.
      DIQQAT: 'too' — imkonsizlikni bildiradi.

   5  'He KNOWS ALL THE ANSWERS.'
      Hamma javobni biladigan bola — AQLLI.
      → CLEVER ('silly' = ahmoq, teskari).

   6  'DON'T GO NEAR the river.'
      Nega bormaslik kerak? — XAVFLI bo'lgani
      uchun.
      → DANGEROUS.

   7  'I CAN'T ANSWER IT.'
      Javob bera olmasa — savol QIYIN.
      → DIFFICULT.

   8  'It was a BOILING ...... day, SO WE WENT TO
      THE BEACH.'
      'boiling' = qaynoq, juda issiq →
      'boiling hot' turg'un birikma.
      Plyajga borish ham buni tasdiqlaydi.
      → HOT.

   9  'He WASN'T SCARED when the fire started.'
      Qo'rqmagan odam — JASUR.
      → BRAVE ('blind' = ko'r, mos emas).

  10  'I LIKE my teacher.'
      Yoqadigan darslar — QIZIQARLI.
      → INTERESTING ('dull' = zerikarli, teskari).


USUL — HAR DOIM GAPNING QOLGAN QISMIGA QARANG:
  Har bandda 'because', 'so', 'couldn't', 'can't'
  yoki qo'shni sifat IPNI beradi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  narrow    = tor
  wide      = keng
  clever    = aqlli
  silly     = ahmoq
  boiling   = qaynoq, juda issiq
  brave     = jasur
  blind     = ko'r
  dull      = zerikarli

tasks.prompt: 1  The streets in LA are very ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
KO'ChALAR haqida → CROWDED (gavjum).
'heavy' faqat 'traffic' bilan keladi
('heavy traffic'), ko'cha bilan emas.

tasks.prompt: 2  The street was too ............ . Tom couldn't drive along it.
tasks.promptUz: Ko'cha juda tor edi. Tom u bo'ylab hayday olmadi.
tasks.whyUz:
'Tom COULDN'T DRIVE along it' — IP.
Nega hayday olmadi? — ko'cha TOR bo'lgani uchun.
'narrow' = tor, 'wide' = keng (teskari).

tasks.prompt: 3  Big cities are often ............ and polluted.
tasks.promptUz: Katta shaharlar ko'pincha shovqinli va ifloslangan bo'ladi.
tasks.whyUz:
'and POLLUTED' — SALBIY sifatlar qatori.
'quiet' IJOBIY → mos emas.
Coursebook 82-betda ham katta shahar 'noisy'
va 'polluted' edi.

tasks.prompt: 4  He couldn't buy the shoes because they were too ............ .
tasks.promptUz: U tuflini sotib ololmadi, chunki ular juda qimmat edi.
tasks.whyUz:
'He COULDN'T BUY ... BECAUSE they were TOO ...'
Nega sotib ololmadi? — QIMMAT bo'lgani uchun.
'too' + imkonsizlik (Workbook 50-bet, 12-mashq).

tasks.prompt: 5  He's a very ............ child. He knows all the answers.
tasks.promptUz: U juda aqlli bola. U hamma javoblarni biladi.
tasks.whyUz:
'He KNOWS ALL THE ANSWERS' — IP.
Hamma javobni biladigan bola — AQLLI.
'clever' = aqlli, 'silly' = ahmoq (teskari).

tasks.prompt: 6  Don't go near the river, it's very ............ .
tasks.promptUz: Daryoga yaqin bormang, u juda xavfli.
tasks.whyUz:
'DON'T GO NEAR' — ogohlantirish.
Nega bormaslik kerak? — XAVFLI bo'lgani uchun.
'safe' (xavfsiz) — teskari.

tasks.prompt: 7  That is a(n) ............ question. I can't answer it.
tasks.promptUz: Bu qiyin savol. Men unga javob bera olmayman.
tasks.whyUz:
'I CAN'T ANSWER IT' — IP.
Javob bera olmasa — savol QIYIN.
DIQQAT: kitob 'a(n)' deb yozgan, chunki
'a difficult' / 'an easy' — artikl javobga
qarab o'zgaradi.

tasks.prompt: 8  It was a boiling ............ day, so we went to the beach.
tasks.promptUz: Juda issiq kun edi, shuning uchun biz plyajga bordik.
tasks.whyUz:
'BOILING HOT' — turg'un birikma
('boiling' = qaynoq).
'boiling cold' MA'NOSIZ.
'so we went to the BEACH' ham tasdiqlaydi.

tasks.prompt: 9  He wasn't scared when the fire started. He was very ............ .
tasks.promptUz: Yong'in boshlanganda u qo'rqmadi. U juda jasur edi.
tasks.whyUz:
'He WASN'T SCARED' — IP.
Qo'rqmagan odam — JASUR.
'brave' = jasur, 'blind' = ko'r (mos emas).

tasks.prompt: 10  I like my teacher. His lessons are very ............ .
tasks.promptUz: Menga o'qituvchim yoqadi. Uning darslari juda qiziqarli.
tasks.whyUz:
'I LIKE my teacher' — IJOBIY.
Yoqadigan darslar — QIZIQARLI.
'dull' = zerikarli (teskari).
Workbook 48-betda 'dull = boring' sinonimi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition from the list. (8 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: on, with, at, in, to
(5 ta predlog, 8 ta bo'shliq → ba'zilari
 takrorlanadi)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  packed WITH fashionable clothes
  2  the most peaceful place IN the world
  3  close TO my house
  4  popular WITH children
  5  the second turning ON your left
  6  study AT Oxford University
  7  born ON 6th August, 1981
  8  died IN 1963


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Do'kon moda kiyimlar bilan to'lib ketgan edi.
  2  Bu — dunyodagi eng tinch joy.
  3  Maktabim uyimga yaqin.
  4  Futbol bolalar orasida mashhur.
  5  Vokzalga borish uchun chapdagi ikkinchi
     burilishga kiring.
  6  Bob Oksford universitetida o'qimoqchi.
  7  Aleks 1981-yil 6-avgustda tug'ilgan.
  8  Jon F. Kennedi 1963-yilda vafot etgan.


QAYSI PREDLOG NECHA MARTA:
  WITH — 2 marta (1, 4)
  IN   — 2 marta (2, 8)
  ON   — 2 marta (5, 7)
  TO   — 1 marta (3)
  AT   — 1 marta (6)


QOIDALAR — GURUHLAR BO'YIChA:

  TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR:
     packed WITH ...   (... bilan to'lib ketgan)
     popular WITH ...  (... orasida mashhur)
     close TO ...      (... ga yaqin)
     Bu uchtasi Coursebook 84-bet, 6-mashqda
     va Workbook 48-bet, 5-mashqda ham bor edi.

  ORTTIRMA DARAJA + JOY:
     the most peaceful place IN the world

  MUASSASA:
     study AT Oxford University
     ('at school', 'at university' — artiklsiz)

  YO'L KO'RSATISh:
     the second turning ON your left
     ('on the left/right' — predlog ON)

  SANA VA YIL — ENG MUHIM FARQ:
     ANIQ SANA  →  ON
        ON 6th August, 1981
        ON Monday, ON 1st May
     FAQAT YIL  →  IN
        IN 1963
        IN 2024
     OY yoki FASL → IN
        IN August, IN summer


DIQQAT — 7 va 8-BANDLAR JUFTLIKDA:
  Kitob ataylab yonma-yon bergan:
     'born ON 6th August, 1981'  (aniq sana)
     'died IN 1963'              (faqat yil)
  Bu — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joy.


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN — VAQT PREDLOGLARI:
     AT + soat        (at 5 o'clock, at night)
     ON + kun/sana    (on Monday, on 6th August)
     IN + oy/yil/fasl (in August, in 1963,
                       in summer, in the morning)

tasks.prompt: 1  The shop was packed ............ fashionable clothes.
tasks.whyUz:
'packed WITH ...' — turg'un birikma
(... bilan to'lib ketgan).
TO'LGANLIK doim WITH bilan.
Coursebook 83-bet: 'a place PACKED WITH
celebrities'.
tasks.speak: 1  The shop was packed ............ fashionable clothes.

tasks.prompt: 2  This is the most peaceful place ............ the world.
tasks.whyUz:
'the most peaceful' — ORTTIRMA daraja +
'the world' — JOY → IN.
Grammar 52-bet: 'the ... IN' (joy bilan).
tasks.speak: 2  This is the most peaceful place ............ the world.

tasks.prompt: 3  My school is close ............ my house.
tasks.whyUz:
'close TO ...' — turg'un birikma (... ga yaqin).
DOIM 'to' bilan.
DIQQAT: sinonimi 'near' esa predlogSIZ:
'near my house'.
tasks.speak: 3  My school is close ............ my house.

tasks.prompt: 4  Football is popular ............ children.
tasks.whyUz:
'popular WITH ...' — turg'un birikma
(... orasida mashhur).
'popular FOR' XATO.
Workbook 50-bet, 14-mashqda ham shu xato
tuzatilgan edi.
tasks.speak: 4  Football is popular ............ children.

tasks.prompt: 5  To get to the station, take the second turning ............ your left.
tasks.whyUz:
'ON your left / ON your right' — yo'l
ko'rsatish iborasi.
'a turning' = burilish.
'in your left' XATO.
tasks.speak: 5  To get to the station, take the second turning ............ your left.

tasks.prompt: 6  Bob wants to study ............ Oxford University.
tasks.whyUz:
MUASSASA bilan AT:
'study AT university', 'AT school'.
'in Oxford University' XATO.
DIQQAT: 'IN Oxford' (shahar) — boshqa gap.
tasks.speak: 6  Bob wants to study ............ Oxford University.

tasks.prompt: 7  Alex was born ............ 6th August, 1981.
tasks.whyUz:
ANIQ SANA → ON.
'ON 6th August, 1981'.
DIQQAT: 8-band bilan SOLISHTIRING —
u yerda faqat YIL bor → 'IN'.
Bu — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joy.
tasks.speak: 7  Alex was born ............ 6th August, 1981.

tasks.prompt: 8  John F. Kennedy died ............ 1963.
tasks.whyUz:
FAQAT YIL → IN.
'IN 1963'.
DIQQAT: 7-band bilan SOLISHTIRING —
u yerda ANIQ SANA bor → 'ON'.
QOIDA: AT + soat, ON + kun/sana,
IN + oy/yil/fasl.
tasks.speak: 8  John F. Kennedy died ............ 1963.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct adverb. (8 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATDAN RAVISh YASASh — Unit 11 ning
asosiy mavzusi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  loud      →  LOUDLY
  2  tight     →  TIGHTLY
  3  sleepy    →  SLEEPILY
  4  nervous   →  NERVOUSLY
  5  happy     →  HAPPILY
  6  careful   →  CAREFULLY
  7  desperate →  DESPERATELY
  8  good      →  WELL


QOIDALAR:

  1) ODATDA: sifat + -LY
        loud      → loudLY
        tight     → tightLY
        nervous   → nervousLY
        careful   → carefulLY

  2) '-Y' bilan tugasa: '-y' tushadi, '-ILY'
        sleepy → sleepILY
        happy  → happILY
        easy   → easILY
        angry  → angrILY

  3) '-E' bilan tugasa: 'e' TUShADI, '-LY'
        desperate → desperatELY
     DIQQAT: bu yerda 'e' TUSHMAYDI —
     'desperate' + 'ly' = 'desperately'.
     ('e' faqat 'true → truly' kabi kam
      hollarda tushadi.)

  4) NOTO'G'RI (yodlash kerak):
        good → WELL
     'goodly' XATO.
     Boshqa noto'g'ri ravishlar:
        fast → fast   (o'zgarmaydi)
        hard → hard   (o'zgarmaydi)
        late → late   (o'zgarmaydi)


DIQQAT — 8-BAND ENG MUHIM:
  'good' — SIFAT ('a good student')
  'well' — RAVISh ('He speaks well')

  'He speaks good English.'  ✓ (sifat + ot)
  'He speaks English WELL.'  ✓ (fe'l + ravish)
  'He speaks English good.'  ✗


MA'NOLARI:
  loudly      = baland ovozda
  tightly     = mahkam
  sleepily    = uyquchan holda
  nervously   = asabiy holda
  happily     = baxtli holda, xursand
  carefully   = ehtiyotkorlik bilan
  desperately = umidsiz holda, jon-jahdi bilan
  well        = yaxshi


BOG'LIQLIK — UNIT 11 (Coursebook 78-81):
  O'sha unitda ravishlar hikoyada ishlatilgan edi:
  'She walked NERVOUSLY to the door and listened
   CAREFULLY.'
  (Workbook 47-bet, 15-mashq)

tasks.whyUz:
loud + LY = LOUDLY (baland ovozda).
Eng oddiy qoida — hech narsa o'zgarmaydi.

tight + LY = TIGHTLY (mahkam).
'to hold on tightly' = mahkam ushlamoq.

'-y' TUSHADI, '-ILY' qo'shiladi:
sleepy → sleepILY (uyquchan holda).
'sleepyly' XATO.

nervous + LY = NERVOUSLY (asabiy holda).
Workbook 47-bet: 'She walked NERVOUSLY to the
door.'

'-y' TUSHADI, '-ILY' qo'shiladi:
happy → happILY (xursand holda).
3-band bilan bir xil qoida.

careful + LY = CAREFULLY (ehtiyotkorlik bilan).
DIQQAT: ikkita 'l' bo'ladi (carefuL + Ly).
Grammar 55-bet, 12-mashq: 'My father always
drives very CAREFULLY.'

desperate + LY = DESPERATELY
(umidsiz holda, jon-jahdi bilan).
DIQQAT: 'e' TUSHMAYDI — shunchaki '-ly'
qo'shiladi.

good → WELL (NOTO'G'RI ravish).
'goodly' XATO.

ENG MUHIM FARQ:
  'good' — SIFAT: a GOOD student
  'well' — RAVISH: He speaks WELL

  'He speaks English WELL.'  ✓
  'He speaks English good.'  ✗

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct words from the list, then ask and answer questions about Winston Churchill. (9 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri so'zlarni to'ldiring, so'ng Uinston Cherchill haqida savol berib, javob bering. (9 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta so'z, 9 ta bo'shliq):
  education, famous, born, helped, studied,
  loved, worked, married, died


TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Winston Churchill was a 1) FAMOUS British
  politician. He was 2) BORN in Oxfordshire,
  England, on 30th November, 1874.

  He 3) STUDIED at the Royal Military College in
  Sandhurst. After he completed his 4) EDUCATION
  in 1896, he became a journalist and 5) WORKED
  for a newspaper. Three years later he became a
  politician.

  He became Prime Minister in 1940. He was very
  popular. The people 6) LOVED him for his
  strength and wisdom. He 7) HELPED his country
  very much during the Second World War. He
  8) MARRIED Clementine Hozier in 1908.

  Churchill 9) DIED at home in 1965. He was 91

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN MA'LUMOT KARTOChKASI:

  BETTE DAVIS
  famous film and theatre actress

  BORN:     Lowell, Massachusetts, in the USA /
            5th April, 1908
  STUDIED:  drama / New York
  1931:     go to Hollywood
  1935:     win / Oscar for Best Actress
  POPULAR:  because of her beauty and talent
  MARRIED:  Gary Marrill / 1950
  DIED:     1989 / Paris, France


TO'LIQ NAMUNA TARJIMAI HOL:

  BETTE DAVIS

  Bette Davis was a famous film and theatre
  actress. She was born in Lowell, Massachusetts,
  in the USA, on 5th April, 1908.

  She studied drama in New York. In 1931 she went
  to Hollywood and in 1935 she won an Oscar for
  Best Actress.

  She was very popular because of her beauty and
  talent. She married Gary Marrill in 1950.

  Bette Davis died in Paris, France, in 1989.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  BETT DEVIS

  Bett Devis mashhur kino va teatr aktrisasi edi.
  U 1908-yil 5-aprelda AQShning Massachusets
  shtatidagi Louell shahrida tug'ilgan.

  U Nyu-Yorkda dramaturgiyani o'rgangan.
  1931-yilda Gollivudga bordi va 1935-yilda
  'Eng yaxshi aktrisa' nominatsiyasida Oskar
  mukofotini qo'lga kiritdi.

  U go'zalligi va iste'dodi tufayli juda mashhur
  edi. U 1950-yilda Geri Merrilga turmushga
  chiqdi.

  Bett Devis 1989-yilda Fransiyaning Parij
  shahrida vafot etdi.


TUZILISh — 10-MAShQDAGI ChERChILL MATNI KABI:

  1-xatboshi:  kim edi + qayerda va qachon
               tug'ilgan
  2-xatboshi:  ta'lim + kariyera voqealari
               (yillar bilan)
  3-xatboshi:  nega mashhur + shaxsiy hayot
  4-xatboshi:  qachon va qayerda vafot etgan


KARTOChKADAN GAPGA — QANDAY AYLANTIRISh:

  'BORN: Lowell, Massachusetts / 5th April, 1908'
     → 'She WAS BORN IN Lowell, Massachusetts,
        ON 5th April, 1908.'
     JOY → IN,  ANIQ SANA → ON

  'STUDIED: drama / New York'
     → 'She STUDIED drama IN New York.'

  '1931: go to Hollywood'
     → 'IN 1931 she WENT to Hollywood.'
     go → WENT (o'tgan zamon!)

  '1935: win / Oscar for Best Actress'
     → 'IN 1935 she WON an Oscar FOR Best Actress.'
     win → WON (noto'g'ri fe'l)

  'POPULAR: because of her beauty and talent'
     → 'She WAS very popular BECAUSE OF her beauty
        and talent.'
     'because OF' + OT (gap emas!)

  'MARRIED: Gary Marrill / 1950'
     → 'She MARRIED Gary Marrill IN 1950.'
     'marry sb' — predlogSIZ

  'DIED: 1989 / Paris, France'
     → 'She DIED IN Paris, France, IN 1989.'


ENG MUHIM QOIDALAR:

  1) HAMMA FE'L O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
     was, was born, studied, went, won, married,
     died
     Kartochkada 'go', 'win' asosiy shaklda
     berilgan — ularni O'TGAN shaklga aylantiring:
        go  → WENT
        win → WON

  2) SANA PREDLOGLARI:
     ANIQ SANA → ON  (on 5th April, 1908)
     FAQAT YIL → IN  (in 1931, in 1935, in 1950,
                      in 1989)
     JOY       → IN  (in New York, in Paris)

  3) 'BECAUSE OF' + OT:
     'because OF her beauty' ✓
     'because her beauty' ✗
     ('because' dan keyin GAP kerak bo'lardi)


BETT DEVIS HAQIDA:
  1908-1989. Amerikalik aktrisa, Gollivudning
  eng mashhur yulduzlaridan biri.
  Ikki marta 'Eng yaxshi aktrisa' Oskarini
  olgan (1935 va 1938).

  ESLATMA: kitobda eri 'Gary MARRILL' deb
  yozilgan; haqiqiy yozilishi 'Gary MERRILL'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an actress = aktrisa ('an actor' — aktyor)
  drama      = dramaturgiya, teatr san'ati
  to win (won) = yutmoq, qo'lga kiritmoq
  an Oscar   = Oskar mukofoti
  beauty     = go'zallik
  talent     = iste'dod
  because of = ... tufayli

HAMMASI PAST SIMPLE — Unit 9-11 ning asosiy
grammatikasi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  When WAS the last time you TIDIED your room?
  2  They WENT to Malta last month.
  3  Yesterday we CUT the grass, then we WASHED
     the car.
  4  When we WENT to Europe last year we DROVE
     through France and Italy.
  5  They DIDN'T PLAY my favourite song at the
     concert yesterday.
  6  The last time I HAD a haircut was two weeks
     ago.
  7  My sister MADE a beautiful cake yesterday and
     I COOKED dinner.
  8  Sally DIDN'T VISIT her grandparents last
     Christmas, so she WROTE them a letter.
  9  Yesterday we TOOK the camera with us, but we
     DIDN'T TAKE any pictures.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Oxirgi marta qachon xonangni yig'ishtirgan
     eding?

  3  Kecha biz o'tni o'rdik, keyin mashinani
     yuvdik.
  4  O'tgan yili Yevropaga borganimizda,
     Fransiya va Italiya orqali haydab o'tdik.
  5  Ular kechagi konsertda mening sevimli
     qo'shig'imni ijro etishmadi.
  6  Oxirgi marta sochimni ikki hafta oldin
     oldirganman.
  7  Opam kecha ajoyib tort pishirdi, men esa
     kechki ovqat tayyorladim.
  8  Salli o'tgan Rojdestvoda buvasi va buvisiga
     bormadi, shuning uchun ularga xat yozdi.
  9  Kecha biz fotoapparatni o'zimiz bilan olib
     ketdik, lekin hech qanday surat olmadik.


ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  1-BAND ALDAMChI:
     'When ...... (be) the last time you ......
      (tidy) your room?'
     Birinchi bo'shliq — SAVOL: 'When WAS ...?'
     Ikkinchi bo'shliq — ERGASh gap: 'you TIDIED'
     ('did' KERAK EMAS!).
     Grammar 54-bet, 9-mashqda ham aynan shu
     qolip bor edi.

  3-BAND — 'CUT' O'ZGARMAYDI:
     cut → CUT → CUT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     'Yesterday we CUT the grass' — shakl bir xil,
     lekin 'Yesterday' o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi.
     'cutted' XATO.

  6-BAND — IKKI ZAMON BELGISI:
     'The last time I ...... (have) a haircut WAS
      two weeks ago.'
     Bu ERGASh gap, savol emas → 'HAD'.
     'was' allaqachon gapda bor.

  8-BAND — INKOR + NATIJA:
     'Sally DIDN'T VISIT ... SO she WROTE ...'
     'didn't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl (visit).
     write → WROTE (noto'g'ri fe'l).

  9-BAND — TASDIQ + INKOR JUFTLIGI:
     'we TOOK the camera, BUT we DIDN'T TAKE any
      pictures.'
     Bir fe'l ikki xil shaklda:
        TASDIQ → TOOK (o'tgan shakl)
        INKOR  → DIDN'T TAKE (asosiy shakl)
     DIQQAT: 'any' — INKOR gapda.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR BU MAShQDA:
  be    → was / were
  go    → went
  cut   → cut        (O'ZGARMAYDI)
  drive → drove
  have  → had
  make  → made
  write → wrote
  take  → took

TO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  tidy → tidIED   ('-y' → -IED)
  wash → washed
  cook → cooked


DIQQAT — 'TIDY' YOZILIShI:
  tidy → '-y' dan oldin UNDOSH ('d') →
  '-y' tushadi, '-IED' qo'shiladi: TIDIED.
  'tidyed' XATO.

RO'YXAT (11 ta):
  have got, wasn't, were, couldn't, was, weren't,
  is, are, can, could, haven't got

  11 ta so'z va 11 ta bo'shliq → har biri
  AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  Today she IS a famous film star, but when
     she was twenty years old she WASN'T.

  2  There ARE six members in the band now.
     Three years ago there WERE only four members.

  3  A: COULD you play the guitar well when you
        were twelve?
     B: No, I COULDN'T, but I CAN play it well now.

  4  I HAVE GOT five brothers, but I HAVEN'T GOT
     any sisters.

  5  When I WAS young, there WEREN'T any
     nightclubs in the town.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Bugun u mashhur kino yulduzi, lekin yigirma
     yoshida bunday emas edi.
  2  Hozir guruhda oltita a'zo bor. Uch yil oldin
     esa faqat to'rtta a'zo bor edi.
  3  A: O'n ikki yoshingda gitarani yaxshi chala
        olarmiding?
     B: Yo'q, chala olmasdim, lekin hozir yaxshi
        chala olaman.
  4  Mening beshta akam bor, lekin opa-singlim
     yo'q.
  5  Men yosh bo'lganimda, shaharda tungi klublar
     yo'q edi.


ASOSIY QOIDA — HAR BANDDA HOZIRGI va O'TGAN
QARAMA-QARShI QO'YILGAN:

  1  TODAY she IS ...  ↔  when she WAS twenty ...
     she WASN'T
     → hozir: IS,  o'tmish: WASN'T

  2  ... in the band NOW: ARE
     ↔ THREE YEARS AGO: WERE
     → hozir: ARE,  o'tmish: WERE

  3  when you WERE twelve: COULD
     ↔ NOW: CAN
     → o'tmish: COULD/COULDN'T,  hozir: CAN

  4  I HAVE GOT ...  ↔  I HAVEN'T GOT ...
     → ikkalasi ham HOZIRGI, biri tasdiq,
       biri inkor

  5  When I WAS young ...  ↔  there WEREN'T ...
     → ikkalasi ham O'TGAN


VAQT BELGILARI — IPNI BERADI:
  'Today', 'now'          →  HOZIRGI zamon
                             (is, are, can,
                              have got, haven't got)
  'when she was twenty',
  'three years ago',
  'when you were twelve',
  'when I was young'      →  O'TGAN zamon
                             (was, wasn't, were,
                              weren't, could,
                              couldn't)


DIQQAT — 2 va 5-BANDLARDA 'THERE':
  'THERE ARE six members'   (hozir, ko'plik)
  'THERE WERE four members' (o'tmish, ko'plik)
  'THERE WEREN'T any nightclubs' (o'tmish, inkor)

  'there is/are' = bor
  'there was/were' = bor edi


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDA 'ANY':
  'there WEREN'T ANY nightclubs'
  INKOR gapda 'any' ishlatiladi ('some' emas).
  4-bandda ham: 'I HAVEN'T GOT ANY sisters.'


DIQQAT — 3-BAND: 'COULD' = O'TMIShDAGI QOBILIYAT
  'CAN' — hozirgi qobiliyat
  'COULD' — o'tmishdagi qobiliyat
  Savolda 'when you WERE twelve' → o'tgan zamon →
  'COULD you ...?'

exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI DIALOG, HAR BIRIDA IKKI TANLOV
(jami 14 ta).

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  A: MORE beautiful than
     B: isn't as CLEVER as

  2  A: the MOST LUXURIOUS hotel of all
     B: on the NOISIEST street in Rome

  3  A: Was Claire SCARED ...?
     B: she screamed DESPERATELY

  4  A: much BIGGER than
     B: the MOST expensive of all

  5  A: prettier THAN that one
     B: the cheapest OF all

  6  A: CHEAPER than the blue shoes
     B: Are they AS comfortable as ...?

  7  A: Did the footballers play WELL?
     B: They played very BADLY.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  A: Krisning fikricha, Jenni Meridan
        go'zalroq.
     B: Ha, lekin u Meri chalik aqlli emas.
  2  A: Bu hammasidan hashamatli mehmonxona.
     B: Lekin u Rimdagi eng shovqinli ko'chada.
  3  A: Kler sherlarni ko'rganda qo'rqib ketdimi?
     B: Ha, va u jon-jahdi bilan qichqirdi.
  4  A: Semning mototsikli Tom yoki Frankникidan
        ancha kattaroq.
     B: U shuningdek hammasidan qimmat.
  5  A: Bu ko'ylak ana unisidan chiroyliroq.
     B: Ha, va u hammasidan arzon ham.
  6  A: Qora tuflilar ko'k tuflilardan arzonroq.
     B: Ular ko'klari chalik qulaymi?
  7  A: Futbolchilar kecha yaxshi o'ynadimi?
     B: Yo'q, o'ynashmadi. Ular juda yomon
        o'ynashdi.


QOIDALAR — TO'RT GURUH:

  A) DARAJA TANLASh (1A, 2A, 2B, 4A, 4B, 6A)
     'THAN' bor        →  QIYOSIY
     'the ... of/in'   →  ORTTIRMA
     'much'            →  QIYOSIY

  B) 'AS ... AS' — ODDIY ShAKL (1B, 6B)
     'isn't as CLEVER as'  ('cleverer' XATO)
     'as COMFORTABLE as'   ('much' XATO)

  C) BOG'LOVChI TANLASh (5A, 5B)
     QIYOSIY   →  THAN
     ORTTIRMA  →  OF / IN

  D) SIFAT ↔ RAVISh (3A, 3B, 7A, 7B)
     'be' fe'lidan keyin  →  SIFAT (scared)
     boshqa fe'ldan keyin →  RAVISH (desperately,
                              well, badly)


ENG ALDAMChI BANDLAR:

  1B: 'isn't as CLEVERER as' XATO.
      'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl.

  3A: 'Was Claire SCARY or SCARED?'
      'scary'  = qo'rqinchli (NARSA haqida)
      'scared' = qo'rqib ketgan (ODAM haqida)
      Kler — ODAM → SCARED.
      'a scary film' ✓ / 'a scared film' ✗

  6B: 'Are they AS comfortable AS ...?'
      Gapda ikkinchi 'as' bor → birinchi ham 'as'.
      'much comfortable as' XATO —
      'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

  7A/7B: 'play WELL' / 'played BADLY'
      'play' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
      good → WELL (noto'g'ri ravish)
      bad  → BADLY
      'play good' va 'played bad' XATO.


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA IKKI DARAJA YONMA-YON:
  A: 'much BIGGER than'    → QIYOSIY (ikki narsa)
  B: 'the MOST expensive of all' → ORTTIRMA
     (hammasidan)
  Bir dialogda ikkala daraja ham.

tasks.prompt: 1  A: Chris thinks Jenny is ............ beautiful than Mary.
tasks.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'beautiful' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE.
'most' orttirma daraja uchun.

tasks.prompt: 1  B: She is, but she isn't as ............ as Mary.
tasks.promptUz: Ha, lekin u Meri chalik aqlli emas.
tasks.whyUz:
'AS ... AS' qolipi → ODDIY shakl.
'isn't as CLEVER as' ✓
'isn't as cleverer as' ✗

tasks.prompt: 2  A: This is the ............ hotel of all.
tasks.whyUz:
'THE ... OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'luxurious' — 4 bo'g'in → THE MOST LUXURIOUS.

tasks.prompt: 2  B: But it's on the ............ street in Rome.
tasks.promptUz: Lekin u Rimdagi eng shovqinli ko'chada.
tasks.whyUz:
'THE ... IN Rome' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'noisy' — '-y' tushadi → THE NOISIEST.
'noisier' qiyosiy daraja uchun ('than' kerak
bo'lardi).

tasks.prompt: 3  A: Was Claire ............ when she saw the lions?
tasks.whyUz:
'scary'  = qo'rqinchli (NARSA haqida)
'scared' = qo'rqib ketgan (ODAM haqida)
Kler — ODAM → SCARED.
'a scary film' ✓ / 'a scared film' ✗

tasks.prompt: 3  B: Yes, and she screamed ............ .
tasks.promptUz: Ha, va u jon-jahdi bilan qichqirdi.
tasks.whyUz:
'screamed' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
desperate (sifat) → DESPERATELY (ravish).
90-betdagi 4-mashqda ham shu juftlik bor edi.

tasks.prompt: 4  A: Sam's motorbike is much ............ than Tom's or Frank's.
tasks.promptUz: Semning mototsikli Tom yoki Frankникidan ancha kattaroq.
tasks.whyUz:
'MUCH' va 'THAN' — ikkalasi ham QIYOSIY
darajani talab qiladi.
'big' → BIGGER (undosh IKKILANADI).
'much biggest' XATO.

tasks.prompt: 4  B: It's also the ............ expensive of all.
tasks.whyUz:
'THE ... OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA daraja → MOST.
'the more expensive' XATO.
DIQQAT: bir dialogda A da QIYOSIY, B da
ORTTIRMA daraja.

tasks.prompt: 5  A: This dress is prettier ............ that one.
tasks.whyUz:
'prettIER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
'as' faqat 'as ... as' qolipida.
'that one' = 'that dress' o'rniga.

tasks.prompt: 5  B: Yes, and it is also the cheapest ............ all.
tasks.promptUz: Ha, va u hammasidan arzon ham.
tasks.whyUz:
'the cheapEST' ORTTIRMA + 'ALL' GURUH → OF.
'of all' = hammasidan.
'IN' esa JOY bilan ishlatiladi
('the cheapest IN town').

tasks.prompt: 6  A: The black shoes are ............ than the blue shoes.
tasks.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'cheap' → CHEAPER.
'cheapest than' XATO.

tasks.prompt: 6  B: Are they ............ comfortable as the blue ones?
tasks.whyUz:
Gapda IKKINCHI 'as' allaqachon bor →
birinchi ham 'AS': 'AS comfortable AS'.
'much comfortable' XATO — 'much' faqat
QIYOSIY daraja bilan ('much MORE comfortable').

tasks.prompt: 7  A: Did the footballers play ............ yesterday?
tasks.whyUz:
'play' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
good (sifat) → WELL (ravish, NOTO'G'RI shakl).
'play good' XATO.
90-betdagi 4-mashqning 8-bandi ham shu.

tasks.prompt: 7  B: No, they didn't. They played very ............ .
tasks.promptUz: Yo'q, o'ynashmadi. Ular juda yomon o'ynashdi.
tasks.whyUz:
'played' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
bad (sifat) → BADLY (ravish).
'played bad' XATO.
'well' ning aksi.

exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP BOShI va OLTI DAVOMI.
Har birida BOG'LOVChI bor — u kalitni beradi.

Kitob BIRINChISINI chizib bergan: 1 → b


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1 → b   because  (SABAB)
  2 → d   and      (QO'SHISH)
  3 → f   when     (VAQT)
  4 → a   but      (QARAMA-QARSHILIK)
  5 → e   then     (KETMA-KETLIK)
  6 → c   so       (NATIJA)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

  1  The children couldn't go to the concert
     BECAUSE they didn't have any money.

  2  Paul married Elizabeth AND they had four
     children.

  3  We were in the fishing boat WHEN it started
     to rain.

  4  I wanted to make a cake, BUT I didn't have
     any sugar or flour.

  5  First, they got into the canoe, THEN they
     started paddling down the river.

  6  Roberta didn't like any of the souvenirs,
     SO she didn't buy any.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Bolalar konsertga bora olmadilar, chunki
     ularda pul yo'q edi.
  2  Pol Elizabetga uylandi va ularning to'rtta
     farzandi bo'ldi.
  3  Yomg'ir yog'a boshlaganda biz baliqchi
     qayig'ida edik.
  4  Men tort pishirmoqchi edim, lekin menda
     shakar ham, un ham yo'q edi.
  5  Avval ular kanoega chiqishdi, keyin daryo
     bo'ylab eshkak eshishni boshlashdi.
  6  Robertaga esdalik sovg'alarning hech biri
     yoqmadi, shuning uchun u hech narsa sotib
     olmadi.


BOG'LOVChILAR JADVALI (Unit 11, Workbook 45-bet):

  BECAUSE →  SABAB
     Nega bora olmadilar? — pul yo'q edi.

  AND     →  QO'SHISH
     Uylandi + farzandlari bo'ldi (bir yo'nalish).

  WHEN    →  VAQT
     Qachon? — yomg'ir boshlaganda.

  BUT     →  QARAMA-QARSHILIK
     Xohladi ↔ lekin masalliq yo'q edi.

  THEN    →  KETMA-KETLIK
     'FIRST ... THEN ...' — juftlik.

  SO      →  NATIJA
     Yoqmadi → shuning uchun sotib olmadi.


QO'ShIMChA IPLAR — MANTIQ:

  5-BAND ENG OSON:
     'FIRST, they got into the canoe' —
     'first' so'zi 'THEN' ni talab qiladi.
     'First ... then ...' — turg'un juftlik.

  2-BAND:
     'Paul MARRIED Elizabeth' + 'they had four
      CHILDREN' — oila mavzusi, bir yo'nalish → AND.

  3-BAND:
     'We WERE in the boat' + 'it STARTED to rain' —
     ikki voqea BIR VAQTDA → WHEN.


DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKOR GAPLARDA:
  1b: 'they DIDN'T have ANY money'
  4a: 'I DIDN'T have ANY sugar or flour'
  6:  'Roberta DIDN'T like ANY of the souvenirs'
  6c: 'she DIDN'T buy ANY'
  Hammasi INKOR gap → 'any' ('some' emas).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  flour        = un ('flower' — gul; bir xil
                 o'qiladi, boshqa ma'no!)
  a canoe      = kanoe
  to paddle    = eshkak eshmoq
  a fishing boat = baliqchi qayig'i
  a souvenir   = esdalik sovg'a

exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta ibora, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  lucky to be alive, I suppose, back then, though,
  who did, was fantastic, did you go, can you tell me


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  BACK THEN
  2  I SUPPOSE
  3  LUCKY TO BE ALIVE
  4  THOUGH
  5  DID YOU GO
  6  CAN YOU TELL ME
  7  WHO DID
  8  WAS FANTASTIC


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR VA TARJIMASI:

  1  A: Grandad, what was it like when you were a
        boy?
     B: Oh, life was very difficult BACK THEN!
     (Bobojon, bola bo'lganingizda hayot qanday
      edi? — Oh, o'sha paytlarda hayot juda
      qiyin edi!)

  2  A: We can't afford this hotel. It's too
        expensive!
     B: Oh, I SUPPOSE you're right. Let's look for
        something cheaper.
     (Bu mehmonxonaga imkonimiz yetmaydi. U juda
      qimmat! — Ha, sen haqsan shekilli. Kel
      arzonrog'ini qidiraylik.)

  3  A: Lions are very dangerous animals. You're
        LUCKY TO BE ALIVE!
     B: Yes, I know. I was nearly a lion's lunch!
     (Sherlar juda xavfli hayvonlar. Tirik
      qolganingiz omadingiz! — Ha, bilaman. Sal
      bo'lmasa sherning tushligi bo'lardim!)

  4  A: My house is very old.
     B: Yes, it is. It's very beautiful, THOUGH.
     (Uyim juda eski. — Ha, shunday. Lekin u juda
      chiroyli.)

  5  A: Where DID YOU GO last weekend?
     B: I went to the art museum.
     (O'tgan dam olish kunlari qayerga bording? —
      San'at muzeyiga bordim.)

  6  A: Excuse me, CAN YOU TELL ME the way to the
        post office?
     B: Yes, of course. Go down this street and
        turn left.
     (Kechirasiz, pochtaga yo'lni ayta olasizmi? —
      Ha, albatta. Shu ko'cha bo'ylab yuring va
      chapga buriling.)

  7  A: WHO DID Mother go shopping with?
     B: She went with Aunt May.
     (Oyim kim bilan xaridga bordi? — U Mey
      xolam bilan bordi.)

  8  A: Did you enjoy your holiday?
     B: Yes, it WAS FANTASTIC!
     (Ta'tiling senga yoqdimi? — Ha, ajoyib edi!)


HAR BIRI QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'life was very difficult ......!'
     'when you were a boy' haqida gap →
     O'TMISh → 'BACK THEN' (o'sha paytlarda).

  2  'Oh, ...... you're right.'
     Rozilikni YUMShATADI → 'I SUPPOSE'
     (shekilli, menimcha).
     Coursebook 86-betdagi mehmonxona dialogida
     ham: 'I suppose you're right.'

  3  'You're ......!'
     Javob: 'I was NEARLY A LION'S LUNCH!' →
     o'lim yoqasidan qaytgan →
     'LUCKY TO BE ALIVE' (tirik qolgani omad).

  4  'It's very beautiful, ...... .'
     Vergul bilan ajratilgan va gap OXIRIDA →
     'THOUGH' (lekin).
     'though' gap oxirida QARAMA-QARShILIKNI
     bildiradi.

  5  'Where ...... last weekend?'
     Javob: 'I WENT to the art museum' →
     PAST SIMPLE savol → 'DID YOU GO'.

  6  'Excuse me, ...... the way to the post
     office?'
     Yo'l so'rash iborasi → 'CAN YOU TELL ME'.

  7  '...... Mother go shopping with?'
     Javob: 'She went WITH Aunt May' → ODAM →
     'WHO DID' + ega + asosiy fe'l.
     DIQQAT: 'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

  8  'Yes, it ......!'
     Ijobiy javob → 'WAS FANTASTIC'.
     Coursebook 85-betdagi 15-mashqda ham:
     'It was fantastic!'


DIQQAT — 7-BAND: TO'LDIRUVChI SAVOLI:
  'WHO DID Mother go shopping WITH?'
  'who' TO'LDIRUVChI o'rnida → 'DID' KERAK.
  Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet) qoidasi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  back then      = o'sha paytlarda
  I suppose      = shekilli, menimcha
  lucky to be alive = tirik qolgani omad
  though         = lekin (gap oxirida)
  Can you tell me the way to ...? = ... ga yo'lni
                                    ayta olasizmi?
  to afford      = imkoni yetmoq
  an art museum  = san'at muzeyi

sentencePatterns.formula: COULD you ... when you were ... ?  —  No, I COULDN'T, but I CAN ... now.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Could you play the guitar well when you were twelve? — No, I couldn't, but I can play it well now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'n ikki yoshingda gitarani yaxshi chala olarmiding? — Yo'q, chala olmasdim, lekin hozir yaxshi chala olaman.

sentencePatterns.formula: There ARE ... NOW.  /  ... AGO there WERE ... .  /  There WEREN'T ANY ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are six members in the band now. Three years ago there were only four members. There weren't any nightclubs in the town.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hozir guruhda oltita a'zo bor. Uch yil oldin faqat to'rtta a'zo bor edi. Shaharda tungi klublar yo'q edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'there is/are' = bor, 'there was/were' = bor edi.
INKOR gapda 'ANY' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: A is [QIYOSIY] THAN B.  /  A is THE [ORTTIRMA] OF/IN ... .  /  A isn't AS [ODDIY sifat] AS B.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jenny is more beautiful than Mary. This is the most luxurious hotel of all. She isn't as clever as Mary.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jenni Meridan go'zalroq. Bu hammasidan hashamatli mehmonxona. U Meri chalik aqlli emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'than' → qiyosiy, 'the ... of/in' → orttirma,
'as ... as' → oddiy shakl.
Unit 12 ning uch asosiy qolipi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She screamed desperately. Did the footballers play well? They played very badly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U jon-jahdi bilan qichqirdi. Futbolchilar yaxshi o'ynadimi? Ular juda yomon o'ynashdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Fe'lni RAVISH aniqlaydi, sifat EMAS.
good → WELL, bad → BADLY.

sentencePatterns.formula: He was born IN [joy] ON [sana]. He died IN [joy] IN [yil].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He was born in Oxfordshire, England, on 30th November, 1874. Churchill died at home in 1965.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1874-yil 30-noyabrda Angliyaning Oksfordshir grafligida tug'ilgan. Cherchill 1965-yilda uyida vafot etdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
JOY → IN, ANIQ SANA → ON, FAQAT YIL → IN.
Biografiyaning ochilish va yopilish qolipi.

sentencePatterns.formula: She was very popular BECAUSE OF + OT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was very popular because of her beauty and talent.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U go'zalligi va iste'dodi tufayli juda mashhur edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'because OF' dan keyin faqat OT keladi.
'because' dan keyin esa GAP (ega + fe'l).

sentencePatterns.formula: WHO DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l + ... WITH?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who did Mother go shopping with? — She went with Aunt May.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oyim kim bilan xaridga bordi? — U Mey xolam bilan bordi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TO'LDIRUVCHI savoli → 'did' KERAK.
'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
